description: Research a single company through the full intelligence pipeline: Perplexity discovery → website crawl → company registry → email verification → people/LinkedIn. Returns job_id to poll for results.

config.description: Advanced pipeline config — toggle steps: { discovery: { enabled }, site: { enabled, mode, max_pages }, company_data: { enabled }, verify: { enabled }, people: { enabled } }

domain.description: Known domain — skips Perplexity discovery step

max_employees.description: Max employees to extract per company (1-2000, default 20)

profile_mode.description: Employee detail level: 'short' = name+title+location ($4/1K), 'full' = +skills/education/experience ($8/1K), 'full_email' = +email discovery ($12/1K). Default: short

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: company_intel_research
